entries.title: Elderberry
entries.artBrief: One elderberry sprig: thick ORANGE branch, GREEN broad leaf, one YELLOW leaf, FIVE large PINK berries in a simple cluster. Each of these four foreground colors must occupy a broad visible patch. Cyan background.
entries.originalArtBrief: One unmistakable chunky elderberry, fully visible, with one broad leaf-shaped base or leaf attachment as the only garden cue. Use large color masses and keep the primary object immediately recognizable.

entries.title: Plant Pot
entries.artBrief: One flowerpot: ORANGE trapezoid pot body, very broad PINK rim, YELLOW soil surface and two solid GREEN leaves. All four foreground colors are mandatory and broad. Cyan background.
entries.originalArtBrief: One unmistakable chunky plant pot, fully visible, with one broad leaf-shaped base or leaf attachment as the only garden cue. Use large color masses and keep the primary object immediately recognizable.

entries.title: Chestnut Waterfall Garden
entries.artBrief: One chestnut with a water spout: ORANGE round nut body, GREEN top cap, broad PINK inner opening and one thick YELLOW waterfall from it. All four foreground colors are mandatory and broad. Cyan background.
entries.originalArtBrief: An enormous open chestnut contains a miniature waterfall garden: one huge water curtain between two leafy terraces. One large enclosing silhouette and one clear inner landscape, no tiny clutter.

entries.title: Lime
entries.artBrief: One cut lime half: thick GREEN rind, broad YELLOW pith, two huge PINK pulp wedges and one broad ORANGE leaf attached at top. Each of the four colors is a large structural mass. Cyan background. No fine seeds or texture.
entries.originalArtBrief: One unmistakable chunky lime, fully visible, with one broad leaf-shaped base or leaf attachment as the only garden cue. Use large color masses and keep the primary object immediately recognizable.

entries.title: Wooden Spoon Cloud Mill
entries.artBrief: One wooden spoon with cloud-shaped bowl: thick ORANGE handle, large PINK three-lobed bowl, broad YELLOW band joining bowl and handle, and GREEN grip at end of handle. All four foreground colors mandatory and broad. Cyan background.
entries.originalArtBrief: A giant wooden spoon operates as a whimsical cloud mill: a big cloud enters one broad hopper and emerges as stars. Preserve the recognizable wooden spoon main form and one very large mechanical cue.
